title: Yummy Malaysian Prawns Curry
description: A wine-infused, double cream curry with spherified lime pearls, romantic and onion‑garlic‑free.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add the double cream, red wine, and coconut milk, stirring until combined.
Add the lemongrass, grated galangal, grated ginger, turmeric, cumin, coriander, and chopped chili to the skillet and simmer for 3 minutes to release aromatics.
Insert the prawns into the simmering sauce, reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 6 minutes until prawns turn pink and opaque.
Whisk lime juice with a pinch of salt, pour into a small bowl, and allow to sit for 5 minutes to marinate.
In a separate container, dissolve sodium alginate in 200 ml water using an immersion blender, then gently stir in calcium lactate to create a spherification solution.
Using a small spoon, drop the lime mixture into the calcium solution to form micro‑spheres, letting them sit for 2 minutes before rinsing with clean water.
Stir the spherified lime pearls into the curry and remove the lemongrass pieces before serving.
Garnish with torn kaffir lime leaves and chopped cilantro.
Serve immediately with steamed jasmine rice or flatbread.
Enjoy the winey, creamy, romantic curry with a burst of citrus on each bite.
